text: You see Mitch, the manager of the All-In-One Store.
source_text: You see Mitch, the manager of the All-In-One Store.

text: What can I help you with?
source_text: What can I help you with?

text: I've got it all, what's it you need?
source_text: I've got it all, what's it you need?

text: If you need anything, just let me know.
source_text: If you need anything, just let me know.

text: Find anything good, bring it back.
source_text: Find anything good, bring it back.

text: I have all the good stuff.
source_text: I have all the good stuff.

text: Mitch runs this place not me.
source_text: Mitch runs this place not me.

text: I'm off to the Falcon when I'm off!
source_text: I'm off to the Falcon when I'm off!

text: I better not catch you stealing.
source_text: I better not catch you stealing.

text: 你看到米奇，百货店的老板。
source_text: 你看到米奇，百货店的老板。

text: 我这儿什么都有，你需要什么？
source_text: 我这儿什么都有，你需要什么？

text: 找到好东西就带回来啊。
source_text: 找到好东西就带回来啊。

text: 管事儿的是米奇，不是我。
source_text: 管事儿的是米奇，不是我。

text: 最好别让我抓到你偷东西。
source_text: 最好别让我抓到你偷东西。
